{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Since October 7th, 2020, protests have raged throughout many of Nigeria’s cities demanding the dismantlement of the Special Anti-Robbery Squad (SARS) and a thorough transformation of Nigerian police forces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Video showing officers murdering an unarmed man on camera went viral.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Special Anti-Robbery Squad (SARS) is known for routine torture, extortion, and extrajudicial murder, especially against Nigeria’s working class youth.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The protest wave of the last few weeks is the most significant of a series of mobilizations against SARS brutality dating back to 2017.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Nigerian governments have repeatedly promised to reform the Special Anti-Robbery Squad (SARS) with no lasting effect.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"On October 11, the government of President Muhammadu Buhari announced the disbanding of SARS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The government of President Muhammadu Buhari replaced SARS with a new unit, SWAT, a few days after announcing its disbanding.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Protestors recognized the replacement of SARS with SWAT as no concession at all.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The government has given the same empty promise regarding SARS reform since 2017.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Forces allied to the government have facilitated violent infiltration of protests to sow chaos and discredit the movement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
